build_graph_from_particles: build a graph from particle positions, types, and box dimensions using an edge distance threshold
apply_random_rotation_to_graph: apply a random O(3) rotation with pi/2 multiples and reflections to a graph's edge features
create_graph_based_model: create a GraphBasedModel with configurable message passing recurrences and MLP layer sizes for particle mobility prediction
run_graph_model_prediction: run the GraphBasedModel on a GraphsTuple to predict particle mobilities from their positions
review_graph_network_architecture: review the GraphBasedModel encoder, propagation network with skip connections, and decoder architecture
